{{SameName|Voodoo Doll|[[Voodoo Doll (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]] • [[Voodoo Doll|Pizza Party]]}} {{EventEnded|date = 21st of December 2023|event = [[Lunar Overture Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Voodoo Doll |image1= Voodoo Doll.png |mode_appearance = [[The Great Finale|Lunar Overture Act III]] |first_wave_appearance = 8 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]150 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3) |cash = {{Money|200}} on death |hidden = No |fly = {{Attr|Fly|Yes}} |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Voodoo Doll''' was the sixth enemy that appeared in the [[The Great Finale|third act]] of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had a decent amount of health, an average speed and was a [[Flying]] enemy, meaning that only towers with flying detection could efficiently kill it. ==Appearance== The '''Voodoo Doll''' was a levitating doll made out of cardboard. It had multiple patches on its body. It had two buttons on its knees. It also had two buttons and a stitched mouth, resembling a face. There were two large pins going through its torso, one with a blue head and the other with a red head. Purple energy emanated from its body. ==Strategy== *As it is a flying enemy, only a limited amount of towers can deal damage to it. **The [[Golden Soldier]], [[Engineer]] and [[Ace Pilot]] can be quite effective against this enemy. **A few Level 2-3 [[Ranger]]s can be quite useful because of their high damage. **Area of effect towers with flying detection, like the [[Executioner]] or [[Mortar]] can also be useful. ***Do note that these towers have high firerates, which may cause enemies to slip past. ==Trivia== *The '''Voodoo Doll''' supposedly had an ability during testing where it would apply a debuff to a tower on death.[[File:VoodooDollAbilityProof.png|280px]]
